heading, Unlocking the value of Europe for our partners, level 1
Sciensus is a proven life sciences solutions partner that navigates the complex European healthcare ecosystem to get the right medicines to the right patents, faster.
heading, Bridging the gap between clinical data and real-world outcomes, level 2

Biopharma companies often face barriers to reaching patients and supporting them in their treatment for the best outcomes. It can be difficult to access real-world data about how medicines are used and the patient experience overall.
Additionally, healthcare systems often lack the resources and technology needed to fully engage patients and to offer them the support they need when they need it most.

At Sciensus, we bridge this gap – connecting biopharma companies and health systems with patients and marrying skilled patient care with innovative technology to engage and support patients and generate the
needed to produce transformative healthcare outcomes. Our collaborative business model maximises the impact of your medicine on patients and the value of your commercial launch.
Sciensus | The fastest route to patients in Europe
heading, Fastest route to patients in Europe, level 2

We simplify access across Europe’s fragmented systems, helping partners bring life-changing medicines to patients faster. Through our integrated European network, from logistics and late-stage customisation to in-home care, we provide one connected platform that reduces complexity and risk and maximises outcomes.
carousel, Fastest route to patients in Europe
heading, Patient engagement at scale, level 3
Our combination of nurse-led care and digital tools keeps patients supported, adherent and engaged throughout their treatment journey.
image, Icon showing a stylized line chart with the data trending up and right
heading, Evidence grounded in real lives, level 3
With millions of patient interactions each year, we generate real-world data that supports HTA submissions, reimbursement and smarter decision-making.
heading, Trusted by health systems, level 3
As a long-standing partner to the NHS and European health providers, we relieve pressure on overstretched systems while improving patient outcomes.

heading, Technology meets human-centric care, level 2
end of heading, Technology meets human-centric care, level 2

With 30 years of patient-focused care, we combine innovative digital solutions with unparalleled human-led support. We have a suite of cutting-edge technologies and digital solutions, powered by out proprietary intelligence platform, but we understand that technology alone isn’t enough for some patients.

Our hybrid approach seamlessly blends our advanced patient apps and digital platforms with personalised support services from our team of over 500 licensed clinical staff. Whether we’re delivering cancer treatment in someone’s home, showing patients how to self-administer medicines or offering holistic support within our patient apps, the human-touch care we provide enhances the value of the technology to help patients make the most of their treatment.
with direct patient engagement, we generate high-quality real-world data grounded in lived experience – turning everyday interactions into evidence that advances care

heading, A 30-year presence in Europe, level 2

From pioneering patient-centric healthcare to supporting over 300,000 patients annually, Sciensus connects patients and their medicines. Our in-market expertise, based on real-world evidence and insights, enables our partners to successfully navigate the complexities of the European market and get their medicine to patients faster.
, together with our industry-leading distribution hub in the Netherlands and multilingual customer services team in Germany, we ensure seamless support, including:
Real-world patient insights through advanced patient apps and digital platforms combined with personalised human support

link, Learn more about our European offering
We work closely with all business and healthcare stakeholders to unlock European markets faster, improve outcomes for patients and deliver real-world evidence for rapid, smarter decision-making.

Whether you’re launching a new therapy, scaling market access across Europe or supporting real-world evidence generation, Sciensus delivers the infrastructure, expertise and digital capability to help you reach the right patients at the right time with the right support.

Our holistic end-to-end service creates capacity in overburdened systems through reliable and efficient medication dispensing, digitally enabled clinician-led care and engaging patient support programmes that improve adherence and overall health outcomes.

We can partner to expand capabilities, unlock new geographies and provide additional capacity across the drug development lifecycle – from non-interventional trials to launch planning, early access programmes and pan-European distribution.
